concepts.name: Functions
concepts.definition: A mapping from an input to an output.
concepts.source_excerpt: A function maps an input to an output.

concepts.name: Derivatives
concepts.definition: How fast a function's output changes as its input changes.
concepts.source_excerpt: The derivative of a function measures how fast its output changes when the input changes a little.

concepts.name: Chain Rule
concepts.definition: Rule for differentiating a composition: d/dx f(g(x)) = f'(g(x))·g'(x).
concepts.source_excerpt: The chain rule is the mathematical engine behind training deep networks.

concepts.name: Vectors
concepts.source_excerpt: A vector is an ordered list of numbers.

concepts.name: Matrix Multiplication
concepts.definition: Combining a weight matrix with an input vector to produce a new vector.
concepts.source_excerpt: Every layer of a neural network is, at its core, a matrix multiplication.

concepts.name: Linear Regression
concepts.definition: Fitting a straight line to data by choosing weights.
concepts.source_excerpt: Linear regression fits a straight line to data by choosing weights.

concepts.name: Loss Function
concepts.definition: Measures how far predictions are from true values.
concepts.source_excerpt: A loss function, such as mean squared error, measures how far the model's predictions are from the true values.

concepts.name: Gradient Descent
concepts.definition: Minimizing loss by stepping weights opposite to the gradient.
concepts.source_excerpt: Gradient descent minimizes the loss by repeatedly moving the weights a small step in the direction opposite to the gradient.

concepts.name: Activation Function
concepts.definition: Non-linear function (sigmoid, ReLU) applied after a weighted sum.
concepts.source_excerpt: Activation functions such as sigmoid and ReLU add non-linearity.

concepts.name: Perceptron
concepts.definition: A weighted sum of inputs passed through an activation function.
concepts.source_excerpt: A perceptron computes a weighted sum of its inputs and passes it through an activation function.

concepts.name: Neural Network
concepts.source_excerpt: A neural network stacks many perceptrons into layers.

concepts.name: Forward Propagation
concepts.definition: Passing input through each layer to produce a prediction.
concepts.source_excerpt: During forward propagation, the input flows through each layer's matrix multiplication and activation function to produce a prediction.

concepts.name: Backpropagation
concepts.definition: Computing the loss gradient for every weight by applying the chain rule backwards.
concepts.source_excerpt: It applies the chain rule layer by layer, moving backwards from the output.
